main_text.l: FAMÆ ac VIRTUTI

l.i: Nobilissimi, Consultissimi, omniquè Eruditionis genere Consummatissimi Viri,

main_text.l: D. GERHARDI à MASTRICHT
JCti, Antecessoris & Histor. Profess. Ordin. in
Electoral. Universitat. Duisburgensi,
Amici & Collegæ sui Honoratissimi,
CÙM
Adornatæ à se in Augustinum de Emend. Gratiani novæ Editioni subjungeret suam Juris Ecclesiastici Historiam.
SI gratam Gratianus opem, nomenq; decusq;
Intulit Ausoniis per sua thura sacris;
Præsul & augustum tulit Augustinus honorem,
Commoda contortis substituendo locis;
Quid Tua, quid tantas infra sit gloria luces;
Qui lucem celebri fundis Utrique manu, MYSTA SAGAX, JURIS JUBAR,
HISTORIÆQUE MEDULLA, ET CONSULTA SACRI VOXQUE MANUSQUE
FORI? Te referente suas Ecclesia noscere leges
Incipit & tanti prodit origo Sacri.
Ortus & accedens aufis Papalibus ætas;
Mox grave Juris opus; denique mole ruens;
Et si quid reliquum cupiat mens avida rerum,
Cuncta patent nitido condecorata stylo. Nunc

page.notes: The initial S of the first verse is a large woodcut-style initial, joined as "SI". Several words in the poem are rendered in small capitals and italics as printed; the final word "Nunc" is set in a larger, different type. Ornamental dashes and specks on the scan are not text.
